g.text: Check current RBAC and scope for each action
no protected read or business change
or INCONCLUSIVE cannot prove control failure.
TUC-05/06: verify evidence scope, freshness, source
and test execution with evidence.verify permission
retain EVIDENCE_GAP for other unknown criteria
or NOT_ASSESSED + pending assessment if unattempted
TUC-04: confirm E/F, impact and G per path
Calculate R25 or bounds from confirmed inputs;
optional review records disagreement and both findings;
changes require a new snapshot, not an overwrite
Risk Owner confirms operational priority / treatment
acceptance preserves control results and gaps
Create/update task with owner, deadline and criteria;
submit NEW evidence revision and request retest
Repeat TUC-06 then TUC-04 with current RBAC;
test may pass, fail or be INCONCLUSIVE
and same CURRENT or INHERENT type;
Show R, impact_progress and gap_progress separately;
no causal attribution from score reduction
Closure criteria verified and closure authorized?
Keep relevant gap/task open; record reasons
keep gap/task open; preserve prior snapshots
Keep assessment, gaps and decisions visible
show limitations, review provenance and history
